# `notifications.ts` API Reference

## Overview

The `notifications` module provides utilities for sending notifications. It exposes a low-level function for dispatching arbitrary notification payloads, as well as a higher-level helper for notifying users when new tasks have been created.

---

## Interfaces

### `NotificationPayload`

Represents the data required to construct and send a notification.

| Member | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | `string` | ✅ | The notification title. |
| `body` | `string` | ✅ | The notification body text. |
| `taskIds` | `string[]` | ❌ | Optional list of task IDs associated with the notification. |
| `producerName` | `string` | ❌ | Optional name of the producer associated with the notification. |
| `repoName` | `string` | ❌ | Optional name of the repository associated with the notification. |

```ts
interface NotificationPayload {
  title: string;
  body: string;
  taskIds?: string[];
  producerName?: string;
  repoName?: string;
}
```

---

## Functions

### `sendNotification`

Sends a notification using the provided payload.

```ts
import { sendNotification } from '...'
```

**Signature:**

```ts
async function sendNotification(payload: NotificationPayload): Promise<void>
```

**Parameters:**

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `payload` | `NotificationPayload` | The notification payload to send. |

**Returns:** `Promise<void>`

**Example:**

```ts
await sendNotification({
  title: 'New Task Assigned',
  body: 'You have been assigned a new task.',
  taskIds: ['task-001'],
  producerName: 'my-producer',
  repoName: 'my-repo',
});
```

---

### `notifyTasksCreated`

Sends a notification informing that one or more tasks have been created for a given producer and repository.

```ts
import { notifyTasksCreated } from '...'
```

**Signature:**

```ts
async function notifyTasksCreated(
  producerName: string,
  repoName: string,
  taskTitles: string[],
  taskIds: string[]
): Promise<void>
```

**Parameters:**

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `producerName` | `string` | The name of the producer for which tasks were created. |
| `repoName` | `string` | The name of the repository for which tasks were created. |
| `taskTitles` | `string[]` | The titles of the newly created tasks. |
| `taskIds` | `string[]` | The IDs of the newly created tasks. |

**Returns:** `Promise<void>`

**Example:**

```ts
await notifyTasksCreated(
  'my-producer',
  'my-repo',
  ['Fix login bug', 'Update README'],
  ['task-001', 'task-002']
);
```
